cls: Astringent (gum paints, haemorrhoid and skin products)
pharm: Astringent (gum paints, haemorrhoid and skin products)
quick: Per product, two to three times daily
summary: Tannic acid is an astringent used in gum paints, haemorrhoid preparations and some skin products. Significant absorption (historically from enemas) causes liver injury.

dosage.d: Per product, two to three times daily

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Precipitates surface proteins, tightening tissue and reducing exudate.
preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
